description: This is a unit test class for the PredefinedShelfRepository interface in a Spring Data JPA context. It tests repository methods such as findByPredefinedShelfNameAndUser, findAllByUser, and countAllByUser, ensuring correct retrieval and counting of PredefinedShelf entities associated with User entities.

classes.name: PredefinedShelfRepositoryTest
classes.description: Test class for verifying the behavior of PredefinedShelfRepository methods.

methods.name: PredefinedShelfRepositoryTest
methods.description: Constructor initializing the test class with required repositories.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Setup method to initialize test data before each test.

methods.name: findCorrectShelf
methods.description: Test verifying that the repository correctly finds a predefined shelf by name and user.

methods.name: findByPredefinedShelfNameAndUserReturnsEmpty
methods.description: Test confirming that the method returns empty Optional if shelf does not exist.

methods.name: findAllByUser
methods.description: Test verifying that all shelves for a user are correctly retrieved.

methods.name: findAllByUserIsEmpty
methods.description: Test ensuring that repository returns an empty list when no shelves are present for the user.

methods.name: countAllByUser
methods.description: Test verifying that the count of shelves for a user matches the number of predefined shelf names.

methods.name: createShelvesForUser
methods.description: Helper method to populate the repository with predefined shelves for a user.
